quotes.quote: Medjugorje Message,  September 8,  2006  - Our Lady's apparitions to Ivan
Vēstījums no Medžugorjes,  2005.g. 2. Aprīlis  - Dievmātes vēstījums  Mirjamai
(Šo vēstījumu Dievmāte deva caur Mariju Pavloviču, atbildot viņai uz jautājumu: ko tu gribi sacīt priesteriem?)
(This message Our Lady gave in response to the question of Marija Pavlović: 'Our Lady, what do you wish to recommend to priests?')
Poruka,  14. siječanj 1985.  - Gospina poruka preko Vicke:
(Message conveyed by Vicka from Our Lady.)
Dievmātes vēstījums, nodots caur vizionāri Vicku:
(Jakov was sick and received this message at home.)
Jakov bol chorý a doma dostal posolstvo:

Ovo ukazanje bilo je neočekivano. Ivan je molio u svojoj kući. Nakon toga počeo se pripremati za polazak u crkvu, na večernju službu. Iznenada mu se ukazala Gospa i rekla da prenese ovu poruku svijetu:

This apparition was unexpected. Ivan was praying at home. After that he started to get ready to go to Church for the evening services. By surprise Our Lady appeared to him and told him to relate to the people.
Это явление было неожиданным. Визионер Иван молился у себя дома. Потом он стал собираться в церковь на вечернюю службу. Вдруг ему явилась Богородица и попросила передать это послание всему миру:
Marija asked Our Lady, "Dear Madonna, why didn't you give me a message for the parish on Thursday?" Our Lady replied:
Vidjelica Marija pitala je Gospu: "Draga Gospe, zašto mi nisi dala u četvrtak poruku za župu?" Na to je Gospa ovako odgovorila:
